description.value: Bendick's Ice Cream Factory is a locally owned small-batch ice cream producer that has been manufacturing premium Canadian dairy ice cream from the same Vancouver location since 1986. Best known as the maker of Sara's Old Fashioned Ice Cream, Bendick's also runs a public-facing Cash & Carry outlet where cyclists can purchase their full product line — including cakes, tubs, and cups — as well as clearance items from major ice cream brands. A hidden-gem factory stop for anyone riding through the Marpole/Oakridge area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone). The site confirms the business is a real, publicly accessible Cash & Carry ice cream outlet open to walk-in customers. The manufacturing page explicitly lists vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free products among their offerings, confirming those dietary options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities anywhere on the site. The OSM community tag reads 'Richmond' but the address (8262 Manitoba St, V5X 3A2) is in Vancouver — a tagging error to flag.
concerns: OSM community tag reads 'Richmond' but the address (8262 Manitoba St, V5X 3A2) is in Vancouver — likely a tagging error.
Minor internal postal code inconsistency on the website: contact page shows V5X 3A3 while the footer and all other pages (and OSM) show V5X 3A2. OSM value V5X 3A2 appears correct.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible Cash & Carry ice cream outlet operating since 1982/1986, confirmed open with consistent contact details. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Manufacturing page lists 'Gluten Free, Dairy Free, Plant-based/Vegan' among products produced and sold at the factory
